To turn off auto-download in WhatsApp: On Android: 1. Open WhatsApp → tap the 3 dots ⋮ top right → Settings 2. Go to Storage and data  3. Under Media auto-download, tap each one: When using mobile data, When connected on Wi-Fi, When roaming 4. Untick Photos, Audio, Videos, Documents → tap OK On iPhone: 1. WhatsApp → Settings bottom right 2. Storage and Data → Media Auto-Download 3. Tap Photos, Audio, Videos, Documents → set each to Never After this, media will only download when you tap it manually. Saves data + storage. Want me to tell you how to clear all the stuff WhatsApp already downloaded too?
